component.name: Git TUI
component.summary: Interactive, richly styled Git desktop UI

description.p: Git TUI is a richly styled, keyboard- and mouse-driven Git terminal user interface for Linux desktops. It provides a tracking and staging manager, semantic versioning with release channels, a multi-preset .gitignore generator, GitHub connection status, automated multi-arch release binary uploading, branch and stash management, commit history with rollback, and a keybind cheat-sheet.
Built with Python, PyQt6, and Textual. Features a first-run setup wizard, global configuration, and per-repository state stored in .git-tui/.
